title: Nourishing Smoky Moroccan Chickpeas Tagine
description: A smoky and fluffy Moroccan dish featuring chickpeas and peppercorns, perfect for a midnight craving, served in a lacquerware bowl. This jain-friendly recipe is a delightful combination of flavors and textures.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Stir in the ground cumin, smoked paprika, and black peppercorns, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas, date syrup, lemon juice, and salt, and stir to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the chickpeas are coated in a rich, smoky glaze.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the tagine to a lacquerware bowl and serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
